datasets.name: OracleDataSet2
datasets.sql:
select s.name,sum(p.creditlineamount*o.ostat) crm,sum(h.rest*o.ostat +h.duerest*o.ostat) qaliq,
count(*) say,sum(y.rest*o.ostat) ilqaliq,count(y.id) ilsay,sum(m.rest*o.ostat) ayqaliq,count(m.id)aysay
,sum(tov.rest*o.ostat) tovqaliq,count(tov.id)tovsay,sum(st.rest*o.ostat) stqaliq,count(st.id)stsay,
sum(gec.rest*o.ostat) gecqaliq,count(gec.id)gecsay,sum(gecotuzp.rest*o.ostat) gecotuzpmeb,count(gecotuzp.id)gecotuzpsay
,sum(gecotuzm.rest*o.ostat) gecotuzmmeb,count(gecotuzm.id)gecotuzmsay
 from cm_portfolio p,cm_partniyor s,cm_history h,operkurs o,
   ( select p.id,h.rest+h.duerest rest from cm_portfolio p,cm_partniyor s,cm_history h
   where p.partid=s.id and p.dateofconclusion between TRUNC(:dat ,'YEAR') and :dat 
   and p.id=h.creditid and /*h.rest+h.duerest+h.interestrest +h.dueinterestrest>0 and*/
   h.hdate=:dat)y,
   ( select p.id,h.rest+h.duerest rest from cm_portfolio p,cm_partniyor s,cm_history h
   where p.partid=s.id and p.dateofconclusion between TRUNC(:dat ,'MON') and :dat 
   and p.id=h.creditid and /*h.rest+h.duerest+h.interestrest +h.dueinterestrest>0 and*/
   h.hdate=:dat)m,
   ( select p.id,h.rest+h.duerest rest from cm_portfolio p,cm_partniyor s,cm_history h
   where p.partid=s.id and p.expertid=45
   and p.id=h.creditid and /*h.rest+h.duerest+h.interestrest +h.dueinterestrest>0 and*/
   h.hdate=:dat)tov,
   ( select p.id,h.rest+h.duerest rest from cm_portfolio p,cm_partniyor s,cm_history h
   where p.partid=s.id and p.expertid=44
   and p.id=h.creditid and /*h.rest+h.duerest+h.interestrest +h.dueinterestrest>0 and*/
   h.hdate=:dat)st,
      ( select p.id,h.rest+h.duerest rest,h.dueday from cm_portfolio p,cm_history h
   where p.id=h.creditid and /*h.rest+h.duerest+h.interestrest +h.dueinterestrest>0 and*/
   h.hdate=:dat and nvl(h.dueday,0)>0)gec,
   ( select p.id,h.rest+h.duerest rest,h.dueday from cm_portfolio p,cm_history h
   where p.id=h.creditid and /* h.rest+h.duerest+h.interestrest +h.dueinterestrest>0 and*/
   h.hdate=:dat and nvl(h.dueday,0)>30)gecotuzp
   ,
   ( select p.id,h.rest+h.duerest rest,h.dueday from cm_portfolio p,cm_history h
   where p.id=h.creditid and /*h.rest+h.duerest+h.interestrest +h.dueinterestrest>0 and*/
   h.hdate=:dat and nvl(h.dueday,0) BETWEEN 1 and 30)gecotuzm
where p.partid=s.id and 
p.id=h.creditid and /* h.rest+h.duerest+h.interestrest +h.dueinterestrest>0 and*/
h.hdate=:dat and
p.credittype in(17,18) and
o.dat=:dat and
p.currency=o.val_kod and
p.id =y.id(+) and
p.id =m.id(+) and
p.id =tov.id(+)and
p.id =st.id(+)and
p.id =gec.id(+)and
p.id =gecotuzp.id(+)
and
p.id =gecotuzm.id(+)





group by s.name

datasets.name: BONS
datasets.sql:
select usrgroup, description, name, sum(crmeb)crmeb, sum(rest)rest, sum(fullsay)fullsay,
      sum(aymeb)aymeb, sum(sayay)sayay, sum(avtosay)avtosay, sum(gecsay)gecsay, sum(gecmeb)gecmeb, sum(musbons)musbons,
       sum(minbons)minbons from 

(select  p.usrgroup,u.description, f.name,sum((p.creditlineamount-nvl(hh.creditlineamount,0))*o.ostat )crmeb,sum((h.rest-nvl(hh.rest,0))*o.ostat)+sum((h.duerest-nvl(hh.duerest,0))*o.ostat) rest,
COUNT(*)fullsay, (ay.crmebay) aymeb ,ay.sayay,sayavto.avto avtosay, gec.gecsay,gec.gecmeb 
,nvl(nvl(ay.sayay*2,0)+nvl(sayavto.avto*5,0)+(sum((h.rest-nvl(hh.rest,0))*o.ostat)+sum((h.duerest-nvl(hh.duerest,0))*o.ostat) )*0.0003,0) musbons,nvl(gec.gecsay*6+(gec.gecmeb*0.0009),0) minbons
 from 
cm_portfolio p,
cm_usergroups u,cm_history h,
filial_t f,
operkurs o,
(select p.usrgroup, u.description, f.name,sum(p.creditlineamount*o.ostat) crmebay ,count(*) sayay from 
cm_portfolio p,
cm_usergroups u,
filial_t f,
operkurs o
where p.usrgroup=u.id and
p.branchid=f.id and
p.dateofconclusion BETWEEN trunc(:dat,'MON') and :dat  and
p.credittype in(4,17,18,22,23) AND
p.branchid not in (0) and
p.currency=o.val_kod and
o.dat=:dat
group by p.usrgroup, u.description, f.name
) ay,(
 select p.usrgroup, sum(h.rest+h.duerest) gecmeb, COUNT(*) gecsay from  cm_portfolio p, cm_history h
 where p.id=h.creditid and 
 p.dateofconclusion>'01-apr-2014' and
 p.credittype in(4,17,18,22,23) AND
 p.branchid not in (0) and
 h.hdate=:dat and h.rest+h.duerest>0 and h.dueday>10
 group by p.usrgroup ) gec,
 (select usrgroup, count(id) avto from cm_portfolio where dateofconclusion BETWEEN trunc(:dat,'MON') and :dat and credittype in(1,16)  group by usrgroup) sayavto
,(select creditid,rest,duerest,creditlineamount from cm_history h,cm_portfolio p
where
hdate=:dat and p.id=h.creditid and  credittype in(1,16)) hh
where p.usrgroup=u.id(+) and
p.branchid=f.id and
p.dateofconclusion>'01-apr-2014'   and
p.credittype in(20,4,17,18,22,23,1,16)  AND
p.branchid not in (0) and
p.currency=o.val_kod and
o.dat=:dat and
p.usrgroup=ay.usrgroup(+) and
p.usrgroup=gec.usrgroup(+)and
p.usrgroup=sayavto.usrgroup(+)and
p.id=h.creditid and
h.hdate=:dat and 
h.rest+h.duerest>0 and
p.id=hh.creditid(+) 

group by p.usrgroup, u.description, f.name,ay.crmebay,sayay,gec.gecsay,gecmeb ,sayavto.avto

union all
select  p.usrgroup,u.description, f.name,sum((p.creditlineamount-nvl(hh.creditlineamount,0))*o.ostat )crmeb,sum((h.rest-nvl(hh.rest,0))*o.ostat)+sum((h.duerest-nvl(hh.duerest,0))*o.ostat) rest,
COUNT(*)fullsay, (ay.crmebay) aymeb ,ay.sayay,sayavto.avto avtosay, gec.gecsay,gec.gecmeb
,nvl(nvl(ay.sayay*2,0)+nvl(sayavto.avto*5,0)+(sum((h.rest-nvl(hh.rest,0))*o.ostat)+sum((h.duerest-nvl(hh.duerest,0))*o.ostat) )*0.0003,0) musbons,nvl(gec.gecsay*6+(gec.gecmeb*0.0009),0) minbons
 from 
cm_portfolio p,
cm_usergroups u,cm_history h,
filial_t f,
operkurs o,
(select p.usrgroup, u.description, f.name,sum(p.creditlineamount*o.ostat) crmebay ,count(*) sayay from 
cm_portfolio p,
cm_usergroups u,
filial_t f,
operkurs o
where p.usrgroup=u.id and
p.branchid=f.id and
p.dateofconclusion BETWEEN trunc(:dat,'MON') and :dat  and
p.credittype=24 and p.expertid=44 AND
p.branchid not in (0) and
p.currency=o.val_kod and
o.dat=:dat
group by p.usrgroup, u.description, f.name
) ay,(
 select p.usrgroup, sum(h.rest+h.duerest) gecmeb, COUNT(*) gecsay from  cm_portfolio p, cm_history h
 where p.id=h.creditid and 
 p.dateofconclusion>'01-apr-2014' and
 p.credittype =24 AND p.expertid=44 and
 p.branchid not in (0) and
 h.hdate=:dat and h.dueday>10
 group by p.usrgroup ) gec,
 (select usrgroup, count(id) avto from cm_portfolio where dateofconclusion BETWEEN trunc(:dat,'MON') and :dat and credittype in(1,16)  group by usrgroup) sayavto
,(select creditid,rest,duerest,creditlineamount from cm_history h,cm_portfolio p
where
hdate=:dat and p.id=h.creditid and  credittype in(1,16)) hh
where p.usrgroup=u.id and
p.branchid=f.id and
p.dateofconclusion>'01-apr-2014'   and
p.credittype in(24)  and(p.expertid=44) AND
p.branchid not in (0) and
p.currency=o.val_kod and
o.dat=:dat and
p.usrgroup=ay.usrgroup(+) and
p.usrgroup=gec.usrgroup(+)and
p.usrgroup=sayavto.usrgroup(+)and
p.id=h.creditid and
h.hdate=:dat and 
p.id=hh.creditid(+) 

group by p.usrgroup, u.description, f.name,ay.crmebay,sayay,gec.gecsay,gecmeb ,sayavto.avto)
group by usrgroup, description, name

datasets.name: OracleDataSet3
datasets.sql:
select p.numberofcredit,b.name, p.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract, py.paydate, h.rest,h.interestrest,h.duerest,h.dueinterestrest,
 py.payedamt,py.payedintamt,py.payeddueamt,py.payeddueintamt,h.dueday,(select valu_name from avalute_t where valute=p.currency ) val,
 (select dueday from cm_history where creditid=p.id and hdate in
 (select max(hdate) from cm_history where creditid=p.id and hdate<=(py.paydate-1) ) ) fristday 
 ,  py.payedamt*t.ostat+py.payedintamt*t.ostat+py.payeddueamt*t.ostat+py.payeddueintamt*t.ostat  cem from 
 cm_payments py,cm_active_credits p,cm_history h,cm_boorowerinfo b,temprate t
 where py.paydate BETWEEN :bdat and :edat
 and p.id=py.creditid
 and p.id=h.creditid
 and p.id=b.creditid
 and h.hdate=py.paydate
 and p.currency=t.val_kod

datasets.name: OracleDataSet4
datasets.sql:
select p.numberofcredit,b.name,av.val_name,f.name fil,m.name meh, p.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract,v.lammount lammount,
(select dueday from cm_history where creditid=p.id
and hdate in (select max(hdate) from cm_history where creditid=p.id and hdate<v.dat)) dueday,v.name ,ex.description ex, v.dat from
 cm_portfolio p, cm_accounts a,cm_boorowerinfo b,provarch v,avalute_t av,filial_t f,cm_mehsul m,cm_usergroups ex

where 
p.id=a.creditid and
p.id=b.creditid and
p.branchid=f.id and
p.mehsulid=m.id(+) and 
p.expertid=ex.id(+) and 
p.currency=av.valute and
a.booroweraccid=v.kredit and
v.dat BETWEEN :bdat and :edat and
p.PERSONALTYPE<>2 and
v.name not like'%Mezenne ferqi%' and
v.name not like'%Kredit tran%'

datasets.name: Prognoz
datasets.sql:
select p.id,p.annualyinterestrate,MONTHS_BETWEEN(nvl(p.duedatefirstcontract,p.duedatefirstcontract),:dat) per,h.rest+h.duerest rest, ADD_MONTHS(:dat,1)fpaydat from cm_portfolio p,cm_history h
where p.id=h.creditid and
h.hdate=:dat and
h.rest+h.duerest>0

datasets.name: OracleDataSet5
datasets.sql:
select v.val_name,
sum(CM_PURDENSAL.odenishmuddet_bol(id,:dat,0,30)*o.ostat) as f30,sum(CM_PURDENSAL.odenishmuddet_bolpr(id,:dat,31,60)*o.ostat) as f3060,
sum(CM_PURDENSAL.odenishmuddet_bolpr(id,:dat,61,90)*o.ostat) as f6090,sum(CM_PURDENSAL.odenishmuddet_bolpr(id,:dat,91,180)*o.ostat) as f90180,
sum(CM_PURDENSAL.odenishmuddet_bolpr(id,:dat,181,360)*o.ostat) as f180360,sum(CM_PURDENSAL.odenishmuddet_bolpr(id,:dat,361,100000)*o.ostat) as f360b
 from smart.cm_active_credits p, smart.operkurs o,avalute_t v
 where p.currency=o.val_kod and 
 o.dat=:dat and
 p.CURRENCY=v.valute
 GROUP by v.val_name
